description: This file declares utility functions for retrieving environment variable values, providing options for optional retrieval or default values within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: StringFromEnv(const std::string& varname)
methods.description: Returns an optional string with the value of the environment variable, if it exists.

methods.name: StringFromEnv(const std::string& varname, const std::string& defval)
methods.description: Returns the value of the environment variable, or the default value if it is not set.
